preflight_scope: Identity, boundary, fallback, and quarantine governance only. This file does not launch delegated model work or change MCP/runtime config.

ordered_runtime_lanes.scope_boundary: Critical implementation, validation, and final review under explicit user/task contract.
ordered_runtime_lanes.failure_mode: If unavailable, do not silently substitute a quarantined provider; move to codex2 or stop with preflight failure.

ordered_runtime_lanes.scope_boundary: Fallback for controller tasks after config/MCP sanity check; not a provider dequarantine path.
ordered_runtime_lanes.failure_mode: If MCP config is missing after relogin, stop and repair config explicitly rather than continuing blind.

ordered_runtime_lanes.scope_boundary: May be used only with a bounded task contract, explicit write scope, evidence artifact, and no quarantined provider route.
ordered_runtime_lanes.failure_mode: If wrapper/provider identity is ambiguous, treat as candidate and do not delegate production-critical work.

ordered_runtime_lanes.scope_boundary: Second-opinion only after a clean preflight; not counted as a verified fallback in this task.
ordered_runtime_lanes.failure_mode: Timeout keeps Gemini out of verified fallback ordering until a later clean probe.

fail_closed_rules: A runtime cannot pass on binary presence, --help, or python --version alone.
A runtime cannot pass by routing through MiniMax, DeepSeek, Tavily, or Brave while they are quarantined.
A runtime task must name objective, read scope, write scope, forbidden actions, evidence artifact, validator, and stop condition.
Local model benchmark results are research-only and cannot become production routing proof.
